# Smit Parekh - Full Stack Web Developer

> Smit Parekh is a Full-Stack Web Developer with 4+ years of professional experience building production web applications for FinTech, SaaS, AI/ML, and enterprise clients. He specialises in React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and AWS. He is based in India and available worldwide for remote contracts and freelance projects.

## Who Is Smit Parekh

Smit Parekh is a freelance Full-Stack Web Developer based in India, available globally for remote work. He has delivered 20+ production web applications across FinTech, SaaS, LegalTech, and enterprise sectors. His typical engagements include multi-tenant SaaS platforms, REST and GraphQL APIs, real-time dashboards, and Next.js marketing sites with 95+ Lighthouse scores. He has shipped applications processing 10,000+ daily API requests at 99.9% uptime.

He is not a generalist agency — he is a single senior engineer who owns every layer of the stack: from UI components in React to database schema in PostgreSQL to Docker deployments on AWS EC2.

## Core Technical Skills

- **Frontend:** React 18+, Next.js 14+ App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Backend:** Node.js, NestJS, Express, REST APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets
- **Databases:** PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Supabase, Prisma ORM
- **Cloud & DevOps:** AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, CloudFront, Lambda), Docker, Nginx, CI/CD
- **Other:** Technical SEO, Performance Optimisation, AI API integrations (OpenAI, Anthropic)
